Sketch map showing federal troop movement routes, engagements, settlements, and streams. Relief shown by hachures. Also covers Nashville city region. Pen-and-ink (brown/red/blue). Mounted on paper backing. Watermark: Franklin Mills. Includes index of troop movements with names and dates. Library of Congress.
